name: Godot Tools
responsibility: Builds the in-game tooling that makes a 3D game tunable and diagnosable — dev overlay, live telemetry, runtime knobs for anything tuned by eye, freeze-and-orbit inspection camera, and parity/invariant harnesses. This is not polish, it is the equipment the other agents and the human use to work. In a 3D game the difference between having these and not is measured in hours per tuning pass, because the alternative is rebuild-and-squint.

inputs.notes: Which systems exist to be tuned
The 'what to build into the game' section is this role's brief
One tool per domain, gated, strippable. Same contract as the web games.
Which exported vars are the real tuning surface
Which shader uniforms are worth a knob

outputs.description: Dev overlay — telemetry plus knobs. PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS so it survives pause. Reads state; writes only through the owning script's exported vars so defaults stay in the scripts.
Invariant harness for anything computed twice (CPU/GPU duplicated functions, predicted vs actual). Optional per game.
Key bindings and what each knob drives, so the human and other agents can use them.

merge.merge_when: Merged INTO godot_dev for small games with fewer than about three tunable subsystems.
